name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched. Start with dumbbells at chest level, elbows about 45 degrees from the body. Press to straight arms, lower under control to a chest stretch.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Chest-Supported Row (incline bench)
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline bench. Let arms hang, then row elbows toward the ceiling and squeeze the shoulder blades together. Lower slowly.
breathing: Inhale as the arms lengthen; exhale as you pull the elbows back.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: On a low incline, with a soft elbow bend, lower the arms in a wide arc to chest level and squeeze back up. Focus on the upper chest.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Incline-Bench Prone Y-T-W Raise
instructions: Chest-down on the incline bench. Raise arms in a Y, then a T, then a W shape, with thumbs up and shoulder blades down and back, resetting between shapes.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Scapular Push-Up (push-up plus)
instructions: In a high plank, keep arms straight and let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away to round the upper back slightly.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Farmer Hold Walk
instructions: Stand tall with shoulders back, hold the dumbbells at your sides and walk slowly in small steps for the set time. Keep ribs down and grip tight.
breathing: Breathe steadily; avoid clenching the jaw or holding the breath.

name: Slow Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands by the ears. Curl the ribs toward the hips in 2 seconds, hold 1 second, and lower in 3 seconds.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Single-Arm Incline-Bench Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest the back of one upper arm on the top of the incline bench, arm fully extended. Curl up without lifting the elbow, squeeze 1 second, lower for 3 seconds. Finish all reps, then switch.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, hips and knees at 90 degrees. Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, keeping the lower back flat, then return.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the dumbbell at the chest, feet shoulder-width. Sit down between the hips with chest tall, thighs to parallel, then drive up through the whole foot.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step back with one leg, lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, and push through the front heel to return. Alternate legs.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the legs straight. Raise the top leg to about 45 degrees, toes forward, and lower for 3 seconds.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg bent in front on a support. Lift the straight bottom leg up to the top leg, then lower slowly.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Standing Calf Raise (step board edge)
instructions: Balls of the feet on the step board edge, heels hanging. Rise high onto the toes, pause 1 second, and lower into a full stretch.
breathing: Exhale as you rise onto the toes; inhale as you lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, knees at 90 degrees. Curl the hips off the floor, bringing the knees toward the chest, and lower slowly without swinging.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under the hips. Lift the legs to vertical, then lower slowly to just above the floor.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Standing Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a slight forward lean. Raise arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, lower for 3 seconds.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Bent-Over Rear-Delt Raise
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back. Raise arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows, squeezing shoulder blades gently.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall, elbows pinned to the ribs. Curl one dumbbell while turning the palm up, lower slowly, and alternate.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

name: Two-Hand Overhead Dumbbell Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Bend the elbows to lower it behind the head, elbows pointed forward, and extend back up.
breathing: Inhale as the weight lowers; exhale as you extend the elbows.

breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

instructions: Elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked. Lift the hips to form a straight line and hold. Repeat on the other side.
breathing: Breathe slowly through the nose (in 4 s, out 4 s) during the hold; do not hold your breath.

instructions: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg, hold 2 seconds without rotating the hips, and return slowly.
breathing: Breathe slowly through the nose (in 4 s, out 4 s) during the hold; do not hold your breath.

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended. Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres, hold 2 seconds, and lower. Keep the neck neutral.

instructions: Sit with forearms supported on your thighs, palms up. Let the dumbbell roll toward the fingertips, then curl the wrist up and squeeze.

name: Seated Wrist Extension (palms down)
instructions: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms down. Lower the wrists, then raise the back of the hand up slowly. Use a smooth tempo.
breathing: Breathe steadily; avoid clenching the jaw or holding the breath.

name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, body straight, glutes tight, ribs pulled down. Hold while breathing steadily.
breathing: Breathe slowly through the nose (in 4 s, out 4 s) during the hold; do not hold your breath.

instructions: Sit upright on the bench. Curl one arm at a time, rotating the palm up as you lift, and lower slowly. No leaning or swinging.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie flat, palms facing each other, dumbbells pressed together. Keep squeezing inward hard as you press straight up from mid-chest and lower back down.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Staggered-Stance Lawnmower Row
instructions: Split stance, hinge forward, dumbbell in the hand opposite the front foot. Row like starting a lawnmower, keeping hips square. Switch sides after all reps.
breathing: Inhale as the arms lengthen; exhale as you pull the elbows back.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Fly
instructions: Lie flat holding the dumbbells together above the chest. Keeping inward pressure, open the elbows wide to chest height, then close back up with a hard inner-chest squeeze.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.
variations: Svend-style squeeze press with one 5 kg dumbbell held between palms

name: Dumbbell-Weighted Crunch
instructions: Hold a 3 kg dumbbell on the chest. Curl the shoulder blades off the floor, pause at the top, and lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Forearm Flexor Stretch (palm up, fingers pulled down)
breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper
legacyMediaKey: forearm flexor stretch (palm up, fingers pulled down)

name: Sumo Goblet Squat
instructions: Wide stance, toes turned out about 45 degrees, dumbbell hanging between the legs. Lower with knees tracking over toes and squeeze the glutes and inner thighs to stand.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of the feet together and knees wide. Thrust the hips up, squeeze, and lower slowly.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Calf Raise, Toes Turned In
instructions: Turn the toes slightly inward, rise to the balls of the feet, pause 1 second, and lower slowly into a full stretch.
breathing: Exhale as you rise onto the toes; inhale as you lower slowly.

name: Bench Leg Raise (hands gripping bench edge)
instructions: Lie on the bench, hands behind you gripping the edge. Raise straight legs to vertical and lower slowly without arching the back.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.
legacyMediaKey: bench leg raise (hands gripping bench edge)

name: Scissor Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs slightly off the floor. Cross the legs over each other in a controlled scissor motion.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper

breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper

name: Frog Stretch
breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell at the shoulder on the side of the kneeling knee. Squeeze the glutes, keep ribs down, press overhead and lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Side-Lying Rear-Delt Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on the flat bench or floor. Raise the top arm from in front of the chest up to the ceiling, elbow slightly bent.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the bench, no swinging. Raise arms to shoulder height, hold 1 second, and lower slowly.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Cuban Rotation
instructions: Elbows lifted to shoulder height, upper arms still. Rotate the forearms up until the dumbbells are overhead, then lower back the same path.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Spider Curl (chest on incline bench)
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline bench with arms hanging straight down. Curl without swinging and squeeze hard at the top.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

name: Tate Press
instructions: Lie flat, dumbbells over the chest with elbows flared. Bend elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the chest, then extend.
breathing: Inhale as the weight lowers; exhale as you extend the elbows.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl each dumbbell diagonally across the body toward the opposite shoulder with a neutral grip, then lower slowly.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

name: Incline-Bench Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie back on the incline bench, arms overhead. Bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells behind the head and extend. Keep upper arms fixed.
breathing: Inhale as the weight lowers; exhale as you extend the elbows.

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
instructions: In a high plank, drive one knee toward the opposite elbow, alternate, keeping hips level.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Staggered-Stance (B-Stance) Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Keep one foot slightly behind with only the toes on the floor. Hinge with most of the load on the front leg. Switch legs after the set.
breathing: Inhale as the hips travel back; exhale as you drive the hips forward.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor, knees over ankles. Hold the position for the set time.
breathing: Breathe slowly through the nose (in 4 s, out 4 s) during the hold; do not hold your breath.
variations: Wall Sit at a higher angle

name: Standing Glute Kickback (hand on bench)
instructions: Hand on the bench for balance. Extend one leg straight back with a flat back and squeeze the glute, then return slowly.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Donkey-Style Calf Raise (hands on bench)
instructions: Hinge forward with hands on the bench, balls of the feet on the step board. Rise high and lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale as you rise onto the toes; inhale as you lower slowly.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch (heel on step board)
breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper
legacyMediaKey: standing hamstring stretch (heel on step board)

name: Gentle Standing Side-Body Stretch
breathing: Inhale 4 s through the nose; exhale 6 s, sinking gently deeper

name: Bird-Dog Dumbbell Row
instructions: Kneel on the bench with opposite knee and hand supported, extend the free leg back, and row the dumbbell with the other arm. Keep the spine neutral.
breathing: Inhale as the arms lengthen; exhale as you pull the elbows back.

name: Single-Arm Flat Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie flat with one dumbbell. Press up while keeping hips and torso square; do not let the body rotate. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.
variations: Alternating Flat Press with both dumbbells

name: Wall Angel
instructions: Stand with back, head and arms against a wall. Slide arms up and down the wall without letting the lower back arch.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Dumbbell Finger Roll-and-Curl
instructions: Hold the dumbbell with the palm up. Let it roll to the fingertips, close the fingers, then curl the wrist up.
breathing: Breathe steadily; avoid clenching the jaw or holding the breath.

name: Isometric Curl Hold (90 degrees)
instructions: Curl both dumbbells to 90 degrees at the elbow and hold still for the set time. Keep the shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily.
breathing: Breathe slowly through the nose (in 4 s, out 4 s) during the hold; do not hold your breath.

name: Alternating Step-Ups on the step board
legacyMediaKey: alternating step-ups on the step board

name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Curl with palms up, rotate to palms down at the top, then lower slowly with the reverse grip. Rotate back at the bottom.
breathing: Inhale as the arm lowers; exhale as you curl up.

name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie flat with arms vertical. Bend only at the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside the temples, then extend.
breathing: Inhale as the weight lowers; exhale as you extend the elbows.

name: Lateral Step-Up
instructions: Stand side-on to the step board. Step up sideways, bring the trailing leg to a stand, and lower slowly with the working leg.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Alternating Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall. Raise one arm forward to eye level with a neutral grip, lower slowly, and alternate.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Hands together under the chest with thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond. Keep elbows tucked, lower the chest to the hands and press up.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Alternating Leg Lowers
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs vertical. Lower one leg slowly toward the floor while the lower back stays flat, then raise and alternate.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Low-Impact Step-Board Intervals
instructions: 2 min steady step-ups, 1 min easy march, repeated, RPE 4-5. You should be able to speak in full sentences.

name: Glute-Bridge Dumbbell Press
instructions: Upper back on the flat bench, hips lifted level with the knees. Keep the bridge steady and press the dumbbells from chest level to straight arms.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: Bench Knees-Up Crunch
instructions: Lie on the bench, legs raised with knees at 90 degrees. Curl the chest toward the knees and lower with control.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Take long steps forward, lowering the back knee close to the floor, then drive up and step through. Keep the torso upright.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Hamstring Bridge Walk-Out
instructions: From a glute bridge, walk the feet slowly outward with small steps while holding the hips up, then walk back in.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Tibialis Raise (heels on floor, toes up)
instructions: Lean against a wall with the heels forward. Lift the toes toward the shins, pause 1 second, and lower slowly. Strengthens the shin muscles that balance the calves.
breathing: Exhale as you rise onto the toes; inhale as you lower slowly.
legacyMediaKey: tibialis raise (heels on floor, toes up)

name: Bench Dip (feet on floor)
instructions: Hands on the bench edge behind you, knees bent. Lower until elbows reach about 90 degrees and press up. Keep the back close to the bench.
breathing: Inhale as the weight lowers; exhale as you extend the elbows.

name: Single-Leg Bench Squat (sit-to-stand)
instructions: Stand in front of the bench. Slowly lower to touch the bench with one leg while the other leg stays off the floor, then stand up using the working leg.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Pogo Hops
instructions: Stand tall and hop gently using the ankles only, knees almost straight, light and quick on the toes. Land softly.
breathing: Exhale as you rise onto the toes; inhale as you lower slowly.

name: Forearm Pronation-Supination
instructions: Forearm on the thigh, hold the dumbbell near one end like a hammer. Rotate the forearm palm up, then palm down, slowly.
breathing: Breathe steadily; avoid clenching the jaw or holding the breath.

name: Plank Dumbbell Drag (anti-rotation)
instructions: High plank with feet wide, drag the dumbbell from one side to the other under the chest without rotating the hips.
breathing: Exhale fully on the hardest part (ribs toward hips); inhale as you return.

name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Step one leg diagonally behind the other, lower into a lunge, then drive up through the front heel to the start.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

name: Scaption Raise (thumbs-up Y raise)
instructions: Raise arms in a V (about 30 degrees in front of the body) to eye level with thumbs up. Keep shoulders down.
breathing: Inhale at the bottom; exhale as you raise; inhale slowly during the lowering phase.

breathing: Inhale as the hips travel back; exhale as you drive the hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, soft knees. Push hips back until the torso is near parallel with a flat back, then drive hips forward.
breathing: Inhale as the hips travel back; exhale as you drive the hips forward.

name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up (feet on step board)
instructions: Place feet on the step board, hands on the floor under shoulders. Keep the body rigid. Lower to the floor, press back up for upper-chest emphasis.
breathing: Inhale through the nose while lowering; exhale through pursed lips while pressing.

name: 21s Curl (7 bottom half, 7 top half, 7 full)
instructions: Do 7 curls from the bottom to halfway, then 7 from halfway to the top, then 7 full curls with no rest. Use the 3 kg dumbbells and strict form.

instructions: Step wide to one side, push the hips back, and lower into that leg while the other leg stays straight. Push back to the start.
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you drive up. Never hold your breath.

instructions: High plank with feet wide, hands on dumbbells. Row one dumbbell to the ribs without rotating the hips, lower, and alternate.
